_about: Written by tools/import_zone_kit.gd from data/source/gainlands_kit.csv and the art in G:/My Drive/Card Game Art/Approved_ZoneKits/Gainlands: one entry per kit id with its lock, family (group / slot), prepared size, pivot (0..1 of the trimmed image), tile size in metres at 400 px/m, sheet parts. EnvKit reads it: every id here resolves like an Environment Kit id (assets/art/zone_kits/gainlands/<ID>.webp). Hand-added keys (height, width, tile, placeholder, slot) survive a re-import; entries not on the sheet (aliases) are kept.

GAIN-BD-ISLANDS.desc: Islands in the sky, transparent sky above.

GAIN-BD-MESAS.desc: A distant skyline of flat-topped sandstone mesas and rock columns rising from a calm blue sea, layered by distance and hazy blue at the back, a few floating islands with grassy tops in a bright midday sky, wide panoramic strip, no foreground (the bottom fades to sea colour).

GAIN-BD-MOUNT.desc: Giant mountain with a dumbbell-shaped cloud, transparent sky above.

GAIN-DEC-CHALK.desc: Handprints and lines. Top-down, transparent soft edge. Palette #F2C14E, #D9483B, #8BC34A, #F7EBD3, #7A5230. Mood: energetic, sunny, comically macho. Building language: Sturdy timber-and-brick mills and gym halls, rope and iron details, red-gold banners. Painted, not pixel: clean bold shapes, soft cel-shaded painting, rich harmonious colour, matching PAINTOVER-TOWN.png. No text or letters.

GAIN-DEC-PLATES.desc: Scattered weight plates. Top-down, transparent soft edge.

GAIN-DEC-SWEAT.desc: Dark mat stains. Top-down, transparent soft edge.

GAIN-DEC-TREAD.desc: Tread marks in dirt. Top-down, transparent soft edge.

GAIN-FX-WATERFALL.desc: A narrow waterfall sheet seen from the front: white and pale-blue streaks of falling water, feathered edges, foam at the bottom, painted, tileable top to bottom, on a transparent background.
GAIN-FX-WATERFALL.size: a strip 2 x 4 m, tiles vertically

GAIN-GROUND-CHALK.desc: Pale sand scuffed with chalk lines and footprints. Seamless, tileable, albedo only, flat even light. Palette #F2C14E, #D9483B, #8BC34A, #F7EBD3, #7A5230. Mood: energetic, sunny, comically macho. Building language: Sturdy timber-and-brick mills and gym halls, rope and iron details, red-gold banners. GAIN-HERO-CHAMPIONS-ARCH.desc: Concept art of the champions arch for The Proving Grounds, 3/4 view, about 12.0 x 8.0 x 1.6 m at storybook scale (a person is 1.7 m), clear silhouette.
GAIN-HERO-CHAMPIONS-ARCH.use: Replaces the arch stand-in in proving_grounds

GAIN-HERO-GYM-HALL.desc: A Beefcake gym hall for the central plaza: red-brick side and back walls with tall lit windows, an open front of four cream-stone pillars with half-height brick parapets between the outer pairs, a red tiled gable roof with deep overhangs and an iron ridge, a round gold dumbbell emblem in the gable (a pictogram, no letters), red-and-gold banners with a flexed arm on the outer pillars, and inside, clearly visible through the open front: a two-tier dumbbell rack along the back wall, a barbell rack, plate trees, a squat rack with a loaded bar and a padded bench on a dark rubber floor.
GAIN-HERO-GYM-HALL.size: 13 x 8.5 m footprint, eaves 4.6 m, ridge about 8 m

GAIN-HERO-IRON-CAVE.desc: The entrance of the Iron Cave, a leg-day dungeon in an orange sandstone cliff face: a dark arched cave mouth framed by rough sandstone boulders, timber mine props with a studded iron lintel, a huge iron dumbbell with red plates bolted over the mouth, worn stone steps going down into the dark, torches on both sides, two squat racks and a sled leg press machine standing on a dark red rubber mat in front, chalk handprints on the rock.
GAIN-HERO-IRON-CAVE.size: mouth 5 m wide, 4.6 m tall, in a 9 m cliff

GAIN-HERO-SKY-TREE.desc: Concept art of the sky tree for The Sky Garden (secret), 3/4 view, about 18.0 x 16.0 x 18.0 m at storybook scale (a person is 1.7 m), clear silhouette.
GAIN-HERO-SKY-TREE.use: Replaces the giant_tree stand-in in sky_garden

GAIN-HERO-STONE-GATEWAY.desc: The stone gateway at the head of the rope bridge into the Gainlands: two square dressed-sandstone pillars on wide plinths with cream caps, brass collars and big gold orbs on top, a short iron arm on each pillar's inner side with a red-and-gold flexed-arm banner hanging from it, a torch on each pillar, low sandstone parapets running off to the sides along the cliff edge.
GAIN-HERO-STONE-GATEWAY.size: pillars 4.2 m tall, 1.25 m square, 6.4 m apart

GAIN-HERO-SWOLE-STATION.desc: Concept art of the Swole Station hub platform (rift platform, banner posts, lanterns, protein stall), 3/4 view, about 10.0 x 6.0 x 8.0 m at storybook scale (a person is 1.7 m), clear silhouette.
GAIN-HERO-SWOLE-STATION.use: Replaces the tavern stand-in in the Gainlands hub

GAIN-HERO-SWOLYMPUS.desc: Concept art of Mount Swolympus for the Trailhead, 3/4 view, about 38.0 x 30.0 x 22.0 m at storybook scale (a person is 1.7 m), clear silhouette.
GAIN-HERO-SWOLYMPUS.use: Replaces the mound stand-in in swolympus_trailhead

GAIN-HERO-SWOLYMPUS-RIDGE.desc: The broken land bridge to Mount Swolympus: a narrow sandstone rock spine with a paved causeway, cream parapet stubs and a lamp post, ending in a collapsed stone arch over a deep chasm with fallen blocks in blue water below, the far spine continuing to the foot of a tall rocky mountain with green ledges and a temple at its summit.

GAIN-HERO-TRAILHEAD-GATE.desc: Concept art of the trailhead gate, 3/4 view, about 10.0 x 7.0 x 1.4 m at storybook scale (a person is 1.7 m), clear silhouette.
GAIN-HERO-TRAILHEAD-GATE.use: Replaces the arch stand-in in swolympus_trailhead

GAIN-HERO-WHEEL.desc: Concept art of the wheel for Mill Fields, 3/4 view, about 14.0 x 14.0 x 6.0 m at storybook scale (a person is 1.7 m), clear silhouette.
GAIN-HERO-WHEEL.use: Replaces the wheel stand-in in mill_fields (turns slowly)

GAIN-PATH-CHALK.desc: White chalk line track over dirt.
GAIN-PATH-CHALK.use: Kit material swap for this zone (path)

GAIN-PLANT-HAY.use: Plant card near mills and wheels

GAIN-PLANT-SUNFLOWER.use: Plant card in clumps along paths and fences

GAIN-PROP-ATLAS-STONES.desc: Four round grey atlas stones of growing size, each on its own low stone plinth, chalk marks on them.
GAIN-PROP-ATLAS-STONES.size: a row 3.5 m long, the biggest stone 1.1 m across

GAIN-PROP-BANNER-POST.desc: A road banner post: a dark timber pole on a stone foot, a short crossbar at the top with a red-and-gold flexed-arm banner hanging straight down from it, a hanging lantern on an iron arm.

GAIN-PROP-BENCH.desc: A flat weight bench: a thick oxblood leather pad on a steel frame with two splayed feet, slightly worn.

GAIN-PROP-CATAPULT.desc: Wooden catapult with a leather cradle.

GAIN-PROP-CHALK-BUCKET.desc: A blue bucket heaped with white lifting chalk, a little chalk spilled round its foot.

GAIN-PROP-DUMBBELL-RACK.desc: A two-tier sloped iron dumbbell rack holding ten pairs of round black dumbbells from small to big.

GAIN-PROP-KERB.desc: One dressed sandstone kerb stone, a long rounded block, slightly chipped.

GAIN-PROP-KETTLEBELL-RACK.desc: A low wooden plank shelf on iron legs with four kettlebells in a row, black and red, knee-high.

GAIN-PROP-LEG-PRESS.desc: A sled leg press machine: a sloped dark iron frame, the carriage with red plates on its two horns, a padded oxblood seat and backrest at the low end.

GAIN-PROP-PLATE-STACK.desc: A stack of weight plates on a steel post, from a big black plate at the bottom to small red, blue and gold ones on top.

GAIN-PROP-PULLUP-FRAME.desc: A pull-up frame: two dark iron posts on flat feet, a steel bar across the top, two gymnastic rings hanging on short ropes.

GAIN-PROP-PYLON.desc: A storybook power pylon: a four-legged dark iron lattice tower with X-bracing, a wide crossarm near the top with three cream ceramic insulators hanging down, a short peak, standing on a square sandstone plinth (no cables).

GAIN-PROP-ROPE-STATION.desc: A climbing-rope station: a timber post with a crossbeam, a thick hemp rope hanging from it to the ground with a coil of spare rope at its foot.

GAIN-PROP-SLED-TRACK.desc: A sled-push track: two parallel dark rubber strips with white chalk lines, and a dark iron push sled with two upright handles and red and black plates on it at one end.

GAIN-PROP-SQUAT-RACK.desc: A sturdy outdoor squat rack: four dark iron uprights with hook holes, safety arms, a long steel barbell resting on the hooks loaded with red and black plates, rubber feet, a little chalk dust.

GAIN-PROP-STAIRS.desc: Wide dressed-sandstone stairs climbing a sandstone cliff to a fortress terrace: twelve cream steps between two stepped cheek walls with brass caps, lantern posts at the top.
GAIN-PROP-STAIRS.size: 12 m wide, 8 m deep, 3.6 m rise

GAIN-PROP-STONE-SPAN.desc: A short dressed-sandstone bridge over a canyon: a flat slab deck, low cream parapets with square end posts, one thick pier going down into blue water.

GAIN-PROP-TIRE-PILE.desc: Two huge tractor tyres lying flat with a third one stacked on them, deep tread, a little dust, for tyre flips.

GAIN-PROP-TOWER-MILL.desc: A tall sandstone-country tower mill: an octagonal tapered tower with a dressed sandstone ground storey and an arched timber door, a red-brick second storey, warm plastered upper storeys with timber ribs, a wooden gallery round the top storey, a red conical cap with a gold knob, and four lattice sails with cream canvas on a dark iron hub.
GAIN-PROP-TOWER-MILL.size: 4 storeys, about 14 m to the cap, sails 11 m across

GAIN-ROOF-CANVAS.desc: Red and cream striped canvas on rope.

GAIN-TREE-OAK.desc: Broad round oak, tyres hanging from a limb.

GAIN-TREE-PINE.desc: Round bright pine in saturated greens.

GAIN-TREE-WINDBENT.desc: A hardy dry-land tree bent by the wind: a twisted trunk leaning to the right, a flattened, swept olive-green crown streaming to the right, a few bare twigs, sparse dry grass at its foot.

TEX-GAIN-FLAGSTONE-ROAD.desc: A seamless tileable texture of a road paved with warm sandstone flagstones, irregular rounded slabs in cream, tan and pale grey with sandy joints and a few small cracks, seen from straight above; even lighting, square 1024 x 1024 (not transparent).

TEX-GAIN-SANDSTONE-CLIFF.desc: A seamless tileable texture of a warm sandstone cliff face seen straight on: horizontal strata in tan, peach and rust bands, blocky fractured ledges and shelves, small dark cracks, no plants; even lighting, no strong shadows, square 1024 x 1024 (this one is NOT transparent).
